name: zdeclient_clear_feature_display_nodes
description: zDEClient::ClearFeatureDisplayNodes reloads feature-related display nodes, clears touched world-area refresh flags, and removes transient ZDEC_FEATURE nodes.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zDEClient feature-map/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x457750 validates iteration from featureMapTree.header->left to header, optional current-ZBD display reload for each non-null key, nonnegative grid row/column guard, world-area lookup through key->listA[0], clearing displayRefreshQueued, repeated FindByTypeAndName(6, "ZDEC_FEATURE"), parent removal loop, display-instance user data fetch/clear/free, DeleteNodeByType, and repeated lookup until no transient node remains.

The native clear-feature-display smoke verifies map-tree iteration clears the addressed world area refresh flag and that a transient ZDEC_FEATURE node is found, its display instance is detached/freed to the DI pool, its type-list entry is removed, and its node slot is returned to the free list.
